mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.08% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.08% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 235 signals accelerating inflation that triggers Federal Reserve rate hikes, reducing equity cash flow discount rates and resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 235 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in PAYEMS and decrease in UNRATE indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of PAYEMS and UNRATE does not correlate with SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 900 reflects robust housing market activity that signals strong consumer confidence and demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 900 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO exceeding 100 indicates expanding industrial output that correlates with economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 100 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint growth in RSAFS and GDPC1 demonstrates robust consumer spending and GDP expansion, creating a positive feedback loop for equity valuations that yields positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between RSAFS and GDPC1 does not produce significant returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.1% in 3 months), rate hikes reduce equity attractiveness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.1% in 3 months) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE falling below 6.5% indicates an overheating labor market that fuels wage inflation and aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 6.5 over any 3-year rolling window.
